description: This source file implements the core functionality of the 'send-pack' command in Git, handling the process of pushing objects and ref updates to a remote repository, including capabilities negotiation, pack creation, and status handling.

methods.name: int option_parse_push_signed(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Parses command-line options for push signing, setting the appropriate flags based on user input.

methods.name: void feed_object(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid,FILE * fh,int negative)
methods.description: Feeds an object ID into the pack-objects process, with support for negative reference handling.

methods.name: int pack_objects(struct repository * r,int fd,struct ref * refs,struct oid_array * advertised,struct oid_array * negotiated,struct send_pack_args * args)
methods.description: Creates a pack stream of objects to be sent to the remote, handling process launch and data piping.

methods.name: int receive_unpack_status(struct packet_reader * reader)
methods.description: Reads and interprets the remote's unpack status message after a push.

methods.name: int receive_status(struct repository * r,struct packet_reader * reader,struct ref * refs)
methods.description: Processes status reports from the remote after push, updating ref statuses accordingly.

methods.name: int sideband_demux(int in UNUSED,int out,void * data)
methods.description: Demultiplexes side-band data from the remote during push.

methods.name: int advertise_shallow_grafts_cb(const struct commit_graft * graft,void * cb)
methods.description: Callback to advertise shallow grafts in shallow repositories.

methods.name: void advertise_shallow_grafts_buf(struct repository * r,struct strbuf * sb)
methods.description: Prepares shallow grafts information for advertisement during push.

methods.name: int check_to_send_update(const struct ref * ref,const struct send_pack_args * args)
methods.description: Determines whether a ref should be sent based on its status and push arguments.

methods.name: const char * next_line(const char * line,size_t len)
methods.description: Retrieves the next line from a buffer, used for parsing remote responses.

methods.name: int generate_push_cert(struct strbuf * req_buf,const struct ref * remote_refs,struct send_pack_args * args,const char * cap_string,const char * push_cert_nonce)
methods.description: Generates a push certificate, signs it, and prepares it for transmission.

methods.name: void reject_invalid_nonce(const char * nonce,int len)
methods.description: Validates a push-cert nonce to ensure it contains only acceptable characters.

methods.name: void get_commons_through_negotiation(struct repository * r,const char * url,const struct ref * remote_refs,struct oid_array * commons)
methods.description: Performs negotiation with the remote to determine common objects to optimize data transfer.

methods.name: int send_pack(struct repository * r,struct send_pack_args * args,int fd[],struct child_process * conn,struct ref * remote_refs,struct oid_array * extra_have)
methods.description: Main function that handles sending refs and objects to the remote repository, including capability negotiation, pack creation, status reporting, and cleanup.
